# libbs2b dependency

This directory contains the unmodified libbs2b 3.1.0 C DSP sources used by
EasyEffects desktop Crossfeed. The upstream files retain Boris Mikhaylov's
copyright and license headers. The permissive upstream license is copied to
`android/third_party/licenses/libbs2b-COPYING`.

Source archive: <https://sourceforge.net/projects/bs2b/files/libbs2b/3.1.0/libbs2b-3.1.0.tar.bz2/>
